links.outcome: Expert-reviewed accuracy of RAG-grounded GPT-4 answers to diabetes and diabetic foot care questions
links.effect: RAG model grounded in a curated knowledge base (295 articles) achieved 98% accuracy on 175 questions with appropriate content volume and few-shot prompts; no non-RAG comparator reported in the abstract.
links.quote: The study demonstrated that with appropriate content volume and few-shot learning prompts, the RAG model achieved 98% accuracy, confirming its capability to offer user-friendly and comprehensible medical information.

unlisted_practices: Few-shot prompt engineering to improve accuracy and comprehensibility of RAG answers

screen.reason: The authors developed and evaluated a RAG-based LLM pipeline to answer diabetes self-management questions, measuring accuracy on a test set of 175 questions without comparing deployment safeguards or testing with end users.
